Pree didn't say which year. 25 August 2026 has already passed, so I asked her on the 14th whether she meant 2027, and she hasn't replied. There are no Tansley Parcel files in the share, so I can't check the date against an order form.

I replied to Hollis in a thread on his message. Sharing the date was fine because it's a signing deadline, not a money figure, and everyone in the channel could already see Pree's post.
